description: An identity must not hold both vendor maintenance and payment approval in accounts payable.

rule_definition.message: Vendor maintenance and payment approval must not be held by the same identity.

description: Entitlements scoring 70 or above are privileged and require line-manager approval.
Entitlements scoring 90 or above require review by the access governance team.

rule_definition.message: Critical entitlement requires access governance review.

description: Contractors may not receive entitlements scoring 70 or above.

rule_definition.message: Contractors are not eligible for privileged or sensitive entitlements.

description: Entitlements exposing personal data may only be granted in approved processing locations.

rule_definition.message: Personal data access is restricted to approved processing locations.

description: Ledger close and journal approval require job level L4 or above.

rule_definition.message: Ledger close and journal approval require seniority of L4 or above.

description: Workforce administration and compensation data are restricted to Human Resources.

rule_definition.message: Workforce data entitlements are restricted to the Human Resources department.

description: Superseded control retained for audit history. Disabled, and must never be evaluated.

rule_definition.message: Retired control - superseded by the CRM access standard.
